results.name: All 48 approved melee variants are active; discarded entries stay absent
All four retired Labrys/hammer variants resolve without Legendary bonuses or active melee state
Every melee instance gets four distinct stable melee modifiers and different items can differ
Point Taken affects stabs only and composes once with random damage/penetration
Standard Issue accepts either primary and EFB AK-74 clones, excludes backpack and AK-105
Spy Main rear hits receive 7.66x damage; front/side hits receive ordinary damage
Shark Bite requires an existing bleed before its hit
Roberto applies heavy bleed only on flesh-damaging stabs
Red Tide increments once per successful attack, caps at +300%, and resets on holster
Third Time's the Chop counts missed attacks, empowers every third, and resets on switching
Crash Test adds fifty absolute penetration after randomized multiplication
Survival Clause uses total health at or below forty percent and ends immediately above it
Full Stride samples movement controls on impact, including movement without displacement
Blood Bank heals ten total HP only once per flesh attack and never restores blacked parts
Trench Foot boosts leg damage and fractures only flesh-damaging leg hits
Bodycam Off and Gladius restore maximum Leg Stamina on confirmed kills once
Movement bonuses scale horizontal motion and motor limits once; vertical motion and holstered movement stay native
Summit and Trailblazer affect only jump/sprint Leg Stamina; restoration and other consumption remain native
The Source adds 25% ballistic jump height and grants fall immunity only when held at landing
Spy Main reduces native movement audio and AI step power without reducing gunshots
Swing speed, reach, and inspect attributes include signature and random modifiers
Draw/holster bonuses do not leak into later attack animation speed
Every Legendary Red Rebel satisfies the Red Rebel requirement while equipped, whether drawn or holstered
Red Rebel compatibility preserves native successes and cannot bypass unrelated extraction requirements
Every Red Rebel inspect description contains only weapon and effect information with no extraction wording
Ordinary and third-party melee never resolve or modify combat
Wombo Combo requires a flesh slash and spends its empowered stab even on a miss
Forwarded Notice requires two seconds of actual sprinting and spends its damage/reach charge
Damascus Delivery grants movement and sprint stamina benefits while preserving carried weight
Catch Your Breath restores maximum Leg Stamina after three stationary seconds and movement ends recovery
Borrowed Pulse restores Leg Stamina only when bleeding existed before a flesh hit
Outta Options checks all equipped primary cartridges, excludes holster/backpack, and requires a primary
Rifleman's Ration restores Arms, clears Tremor, and refreshes its own 600-second painkiller after holstering
True Believer uses the live raid clock with inclusive 20:00 and exclusive 06:00 boundaries
Low Tide affects crouched movement but leaves standing/prone movement alone
Rib Reaper applies exactly thirty additional stomach HP damage after a flesh chest slash
Jarate accepts every sniper-category rifle in either primary, excludes marksman rifles and backpack
Hatchet Job modifies head slashes only, including penetration
Stitch Witch removes the wielder's bleeding only on a confirmed melee kill
Hoodoo removes only its own pain suppression on holster and preserves medicine effects
Paul Bunyan empowers only the first attempted attack per draw; a miss consumes it
Blood Pressure activates only during an existing bleed
Cutting Season ramps following slashes from zero to one hundred percent, and stabs reset it
Campfire Break restores five total HP per second across living injured parts only
Sleeping Bag Protocol applies fifty percent protection only while prone
Scramble Insurance changes vault/climb speed and Leg costs without changing jump or Arm costs
Air Fare gives one half-height jump, consumes native stamina, and cannot re-arm by switching in midair
Air Fare re-arms on a new ground jump and preserves ceilings and native jump restrictions
Foxhole Foreman reduces crouched explosion and fragment damage only
Countermeasure arms on direct external damage and consumes the next attempted attack without stacking
Restraining Order protects against marked attackers only, and clears immediately on switching
Tip of the Argument always adds fifty percent reach and boosts horizontal long-range stabs only
Roman Numerals tracks actual flesh stabs separately by victim and body part
Public Forum counts nearby living enemies, excludes friends, and caps attack speed
Session cleanup removes owned painkillers without touching medicine or unchanged carried weight
Emergency Access opens one locked door without breach eligibility and leaves its four-modifier item identity intact
Walls, unlocked doors, non-interactive barriers and refused unlocks do not spend the master-key charge
Emergency Access shares its raid charge across copies, holsters and recreated actors with the same profile
Master-key use is per player and re-arms only in a new raid world
Door probe requires an active melee strike, native unobstructed targeting and actual melee range
Linked door colliders resolve, while ordinary and holstered axes cannot use master-key logic
Native interaction failures are contained and reentrant callbacks cannot unlock a second door
